# Alka Traders

> Alka Traders is a marine and industrial equipment supplier based in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India. The company sources marine spares, ship machinery parts, industrial MRO equipment, surplus stock, and emergency procurement requirements for buyers worldwide.

Alka Traders has supplied marine and industrial equipment since 1990. Product availability changes with supplier stock, so the online catalog and a direct quotation are the authoritative sources for a specific part number, condition, price, and lead time.

## Product scope

- Marine spare parts and ship machinery spares
- Marine engine parts, pumps, separators, and filters
- Hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, cylinders, and power units
- Pneumatic valves, cylinders, and air preparation equipment
- Electrical automation, drives, PLCs, switchgear, and instrumentation
- Navigation and communication equipment spares
- Deck machinery, rigging, lifting, and safety equipment
- Surplus, discontinued, and hard-to-find industrial equipment

## Procurement

Buyers can search the catalog, request a quotation with a part number or nameplate photo, or use the emergency desk for time-critical requirements. The RFQ form accepts the manufacturer, model, part number, quantity, destination, and supporting photos.

## Canonical URL policy

English storefront URLs are canonical with a trailing slash. Arabic and Spanish route shells are not indexed until translated content is available. Account, checkout, search, password, and order-tracking pages are private and marked noindex.
